subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): identify each instance with service.instance.id

question: Should diagnostics-otel accept a new `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` env variable with hostname fallback, or should instance identity be implemented only through the standard OTel resource path or the canonical OpenClaw identity seam?
rationale: The right instance identifier affects operator-facing telemetry grouping, privacy, docs, and compatibility, and the canonical maintainer-labeled issue explicitly asks for a stable non-secret identity decision before implementation.

options.title: Use Standard Or Approved Identity
options.body: Remove the custom env variable and hostname fallback, then implement `service.instance.id` through `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` documentation or the maintainer-approved identity seam from the canonical issue.

options.title: Adopt New Env Contract
options.body: Accept `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID`, but require docs, precedence, privacy expectations, and upgrade behavior before merge.

options.title: Pause For Canonical Issue
options.body: Keep this PR paused while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93071 settles the durable identity source and acceptance criteria.

recommendation.title: Use Standard Or Approved Identity
recommendation.body: Remove the custom env variable and hostname fallback, then implement `service.instance.id` through `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` documentation or the maintainer-approved identity seam from the canonical issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is listed for Telemetry in CONTRIBUTING.md and has the strongest recent diagnostics-otel history for this exact surface.
